project.name: haven-app-shared
project.description:
Pure-resources jar with the single source of truth for application.yml, Flyway migrations (V1..V18), logback-spring.xml, and static/scalar.html.
Deliberately a leaf module — zero compile dependencies. Both the production boot module (app) and the test-support module declare it so prod runtime and every test classpath inherit the same resources. Without app-shared sitting outside the dependency graph, test-support could not depend on legacy-features (which transitively pulls every feature-impl) without creating a reactor cycle.
